title: Observation
description: ARCHITECTURE.md §1, §6: нормализованный результат одной попытки с provenance и evidence. Absent grading becomes UNVERIFIED — never a silent pass.

featureSnapshotRef.description: Set once the FeatureCompiler has produced a V60 for this Observation. Null until then.

executionAttemptId.description: EXECUTION_SAFETY_RECOVERY.md §4.2/§15 point 2: binds this Observation to the active ExecutionAttempt that produced it. Null for Observations committed via a path not yet wired to the Phase 4.5 fencing gate — see redteam.execution/observation-binds-active-attempt.

nativeProbeId.description: The engine-native probe identity (promptfoo `pluginId:strategyId`), preserved separately from RTAP's own `probeId` so RTAP-scheduled identity and native metadata never overwrite each other.

interceptorPlanGeneration.description: EXECUTION_SAFETY_RECOVERY.md §10: plan generation enters ExecutionAttempt and Observation provenance. Null until an adapter is wired to a compiled InterceptorPlan (see redteam.execution/interceptor-order-is-deterministic).

configIgnored.description: True when the engine ignored requested strategies/domains — duo-agents config-invariance, wiki/Arch_duo-agents/REDTEAM.md.

provenance.description: redteam.observation/every-observation-has-provenance — see law of the same name.
